hints.title: Token Extraction Strategy
hints.text: Split each multi-word text field into individual word tokens while retaining their relative positional order.

hints.title: Case Formatting
hints.text: For each word, convert its initial character to uppercase and all succeeding characters to lowercase.

hints.title: Reassembly
hints.text: Aggregate the modified word tokens back into a single sentence string ordered by token index.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE Words AS (
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(content_text, ' ', 1) AS word, 
        SUBSTRING(content_text, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(content_text, ' ', 1)) + 2) AS remaining_text, 
        1 AS token_index 
    FROM user_content 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining_text, ' ', 1) AS word, 
        SUBSTRING(remaining_text, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining_text, ' ', 1)) + 2) AS remaining_text, 
        token_index + 1 AS token_index 
    FROM Words 
    WHERE remaining_text != ''
), 
Converted AS (
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            CONCAT(
                UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)), 
                LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ) 
            ORDER BY token_index 
            SEPARATOR ' '
        ) AS converted_text 
    FROM Words 
    GROUP BY content_id
) 
SELECT 
    uc.content_id, 
    uc.content_text AS original_text, 
    c.converted_text 
FROM user_content AS uc 
JOIN Converted AS c 
    ON uc.content_id = c.content_id
ORDER BY uc.content_id;
```

complexity.notes: Recursively splits text on space boundaries, titlecases each word token, and aggregates back.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard SQL lacks built-in tokenized title-casing without CTE or regex manipulation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(w * l) temporary recursion stack in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates recursive tokenization and string aggregation in SQL or vectorized string methods.

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            CONCAT(
                UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)), 
                LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ) 
            ORDER BY token_index 
            SEPARATOR ' '
        ) AS converted_text 
    FROM Words 
    GROUP BY content_id

SELECT 
    uc.content_id, 
    uc.content_text AS original_text,

SELECT 
    content_id, 
    content_text AS original_text, 
    INITCAP(content_text) AS converted_text 
FROM user_content 
ORDER BY content_id;
